summary: Frontend-only REGRESSION pass after the lint/build refactor (useCallback data loaders in 5 admin pages, Tailwind [transition-duration:900ms] replacement, build output -> dist). Verified: admin login -> dashboard; AdminEnquiries all 5 filters refetch correctly with correct query params and NO refetch loop when idle; AdminMessages status filter refetch OK, no loop; AdminProducts list (6 rows) + categories dropdown load once, no loop; product create -> edit -> reload-persist -> delete all OK; AdminCategories list (3) + create/edit/reorder(up, persisted after reload)/delete all OK; AdminMedia page loads (0 files, load() fired). Public: homepage renders (hero, 3 collection cards, 3 featured products), computed transition-duration = 0.9s on homepage collection imgs, Collections page imgs and ProductCard imgs (Tailwind class change works); Collections -> Category page navigation renders category products with no broken images. Dealer Enquiry and Contact forms submit end-to-end (dealer-success / contact-success shown, POSTs 200, records visible in admin CMS). Zero console errors and zero 4xx/5xx API responses across all flows. Production build (`yarn build`) compiles successfully to /app/frontend/dist with no Tailwind ambiguity warnings; robots.txt + sitemap.xml now publicly reachable (200) - previous iteration-1 HIGH issue resolved. Catch-all 404 route (NotFound) now present in App.js - also resolved. NO regressions found.

issues: Search input has no debounce: every keystroke triggers a GET /api/dealer-enquiries (pre-existing, unrelated to refactor)
Native <select> still used instead of shadcn Select (carried over from iteration 1)

critical_code_review_comments: AdminEnquiries: load = useCallback([filters]) recreates on every filter keystroke -> one API call per character; consider debouncing the search field (behaviour is correct, just chatty).
AdminProducts: the categories fetch is inline in useEffect and not part of load(); it only refreshes on mount - fine today but will go stale if categories are edited in another tab.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories.jsx (added data-testid category-up-{slug} / category-down-{slug} on reorder buttons - testability only, no behaviour change)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted via UI: product 'TEST_Regression Product' (edited then deleted), category 'TEST_Regression Cat' (edited, reordered, deleted), dealer enquiry 'TEST_Regression Dealer', contact message 'TEST_Regression Contact'. DB verified back to baseline: 6 products / 3 categories / 0 enquiries / 0 messages (dashboard confirms).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct admin testids: product-name-input, product-category-select (REQUIRED - save is blocked by native HTML validation if empty), product-edit-{slug}/product-delete-{slug} (slug from slugify, e.g. 'TEST_Regression Product' -> 'testregression-product'); category-name-input, category-edit/delete/up/down-{slug}. Public forms: dealer-email is REQUIRED (regex validated) - omitting it silently blocks submit; success markers are dealer-success and contact-success (they replace the form). media-upload-input is a hidden <input type=file> (class 'hidden') - don't wait_for visibility, use set_input_files or the 'Upload Media' button. Delete actions use window.confirm - register page.on('dialog', accept). After admin login, wait ~3s (wait_for_url '**/admin**' also matches /admin/login).
rca_of_the_issue: No regression. The two initial in-run failures were my own test-script errors (wrong data-testid guesses and unfilled required fields), not app defects; re-run with correct selectors passed fully. Stale `duration-[900ms]` Tailwind warnings in frontend.err.log are from compiles predating the refactor - a fresh production build emits none.
